decision_cruda.rationale: Central is already truck-limited (loader inflow 117 t/h vs 91 t/h trucks, stockpile 298/450 t). Losing LH-06 drops inflow to about 75 t/h, below truck capacity, so the stockpile buffer keeps trucks busy. Any loan would take a loader from a producing stope or a development heading (up to 4 oz/h) and add little. LH-06 is likely repaired by 11:30 (range 11:00 to 12:00) and can then load the 216 t (about 40 oz) left in TJ-C564-01 before 17:00. Reserves cannot be activated, because no stope has stopped. Radio and CMMS agree on the failure, so no confirmation is needed. Decision: no moves.
